title: ObjectJointUser requires a jacobianUserFunction; the required user functions of the user items are checked in Assemble
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.15: nowhere in Exudyn is a constraint Jacobian approximated by numerical differentiation, as it leads to severe artifacts; ObjectJointUser needs constraintUserFunction and jacobianUserFunction, and a missing one fails in Assemble; check what each other user item needs at least.
releaseNotes: ObjectJointUser needs its jacobianUserFunction: Assemble raises for an active joint without it, as a constraint Jacobian approximated by central differences gives artifacts; the numerical approximation is removed.
